build.script:
#!/bin/zsh -l
set -e

# $1 = dossier du .tex 
# $2 = chemin complet du .tex 

cd "$1" || exit 1
mkdir -p build

name="$(basename "${2%.*}")"   
pdf_build="build/$name.pdf" 
pdf_final="$name.pdf"

# Compilation unique dans build/
 /Library/TeX/texbin/lualatex \
  -interaction=nonstopmode -file-line-error -shell-escape -synctex=1 \
  -output-directory=build "$2" || true

run.script:
#!/bin/zsh -l
set -e

# $1 = dossier du .tex
# $2 = chemin complet du .tex

cd "$1" || exit 1
name="$(basename "${2%.*}")"

# Ouvre directement le PDF compilé
open -a Skim "build/$name.pdf"

exit 0
